newsitems.title: Rip It! Card Collector Launches THIS Friday, October 30th!
newsitems.author: Hepburn
newsitems.contents: Launch day is almost upon us! Rip It! Card Collector is launching THIS Friday, October 30th - in 2 days!To prepare for launch, we have taken the demo down. We appreciate everyone who took the time to report bugs and suggest features for the game. It was invaluable in helping us shape the full release, and we're excited for you to see the changes on October 30th!We also selected the winners of the Discord Community Card Art Competition. The cards will appear in the full release as special, shiny promo cards, along with artist credit. Can you guess what creatures they are?What's New In The Full Release?Your feedback helped us smash a lot of unwanted desk bugs and optimize the game for your screen. You can also expect:1,431 new cards! WOAH!25 Steam achievements.CritDex that includes Critkin information and artist credit.Aggressively bounce a desk plant. Trust us on this one.Accessibility features including the Auto Rip Rig and click-to-flip the page.Black Market. Oooh. And of course, a few more surprises in the full release you'll enjoy. Wishlist Rip It! Card Collector if you haven't already so you can be notified and first in line to buy the game when it releases on Friday.Thank you, and we hope to see you in our Discord to get hyped with the team for the release day countdown. We will see you on Friday! Be there or be square. 🃏Team Ballistic

newsitems.title: Demo Ending Soon - Wednesday, October 28th! ⚙️
newsitems.author: Hepburn
newsitems.contents: Happy Monday, Thank you so much to everyone who played the demo and left feedback for us on Discord, Steam, or through Google's survey. We've been taking the time to try and read through every piece of feedback we've received ahead of Friday's launch.And your support paid off too! Steam Next Fest was a smashing success: we hit 50K+ wishlists. So, THANK YOU to everyone who took time to open packs and fill their binders. We're beyond excited behind the desk and can't for you to see the full game!Missed out during Next Fest? Not to worry - Rip It! Card Collector demo is still up for two more days, so if you haven't ripped your first pack yet, there's still time to jump in. The demo will be taken down Wednesday, October 28th in preparation for the full game release THIS Friday, October 30th! Want to know what's coming? We shared a sneak-peek on our Discord: 1,400+ new cards, gadget upgrades, desk fidget toys, and more. Discord is the first place we share news, so join if you haven't already!Until then, see you very soon!Team Ballistic

newsitems.title: Rip It! Card Collector Hits 40K Wishlists! 🎊
newsitems.author: Hepburn
newsitems.contents: Hey recruits! We hit 40K wishlists for Rip It! Card Collector, and want to give a huge THANK YOU to everyone who played our demo! We're incredibly stoked about this. The team behind the desk is implementing player feedback and tossing surprise, unwanted bug cards that appeared in the demo. Ready to start your collection? The weekend is the perfect chance to set up at the desk, explore the binder, shake a piggy bank, and see what's happening!As a reminder: the full game comes out October 30th! That's just one week away! And comes with tons of new cards (1,431 to exact, if you like numbers), store upgrades, the Black Market, the CritDex, and accessibility features that make it easier on your hands to open packs and turn pages. Play our demo all weekend long, swing by our Discord to get a sneak-peek at what's coming in the full release on October 30th, share your favorite cards, and leave us feedback. We read every single bit! Until next week! Team Ballistic

newsitems.title: Rip It! Card Collector Launches Next Week: Here’s What’s in the Pack!
newsitems.author: George
newsitems.contents: Hey recruits!Launch day is almost here, and Team Ballistic has been busy stocking the shelves. Whether you’ve been ripping packs in the demo or you’re brand new to the desk, here’s a sneak peek at what’s waiting for you in the full game.1,431 Cards You Haven’t Seen YetThe demo was just the warm-up. The full game brings 1,431 brand-new cards to hunt down, taking the total collection to 1,809 cards across 209 unique Critkin. That’s a lot of binder pages to fill, and a lot of god-tier pulls to celebrate! Check out the preview below for some new cards you'll be hunting for. Let the Machines Do the WorkYour workstation is getting some serious upgrades based on your demo feedback:Auto Binder Bot: moves cards from your mat straight into the binder, no hands requiredAuto Rip Rig slot: helps keep the Rip Rig topped up all by itselfRip Rig Speed Up: rip faster than everBinder Bot cooldown reductions: less waiting, more slottingPrefer to do it all by hand? That’s fine too. It's your desk after all.Meet the CritDexEvery Critkin you discover is now logged in your very own CritDex, so you can see exactly what you’ve found and what’s still out there. Pair it with the new stats screen to track just how deep your collecting habit really goes.Get a Closer LookThe new inspect screen lets you pick up any card or pack and admire it up close. Take your time, soak in every detail, and learn a little about each of the Critkin in the process. Promo Cards from Our Art CompetitionNine exclusive promo cards are joining the collection, featuring art from our Discord art competition. A huge thank you to everyone who entered. Now go and find them!Black Market UpgradesThe Black Market has some new stock under the counter. Spend wisely and you’ll be tracking down those missing cards in no time.Something for Idle HandsNeed a breather between packs? Pop the clickable seal, mash some buttons, or give the skateboard a spin. Purely for fun, and very satisfying.See You at Launch!Rip It! Card Collector launches on Steam next week, October 30th. If you haven’t already, add it to your wishlist so you’re notified the moment it goes live, and come and say hello in our Discord to share your best pulls and leave feedback.Happy ripping!Team Ballistic

newsitems.title: Rip It! Card Collector is in Steam Next Fest!
newsitems.author: Connor
newsitems.contents: Attention, Recruit! Steam Next Fest has begun and so many amazing demos are competing for your attention. Obviously, Team Ballistic entered the arena as well!The bosses at Team Ballistic HQ are extremely pleased to share that Rip It! Card Collector is among the featured demos. Isn't this just the perfect opportunity to get new recruits like you acquainted with our operation ahead of launch on October 30th?No more excuses: Rip It! and let us know how you like it!Checking out Steam Next Fest? Looks good in your personnel file! Playing the Rip It! Card Collector Demo? You'll get extra points, recruit! If you’ve been meaning to give the Rip It! Card Collector Demo a go, now’s a pretty good time. And if you’ve already started playing: How’s the binder coming along? Share your experience with us using the feedback form so we can make the full game even more fun (and you can get mentioned in the credits)!The demo features 369 hand-drawn cards to collect... What's your favorite? The Demo includes:Packs to crack and cards to collectBinder slots to fillDuplicates to sell for profitGear and workstation upgradesRelaxing, low-pressure progressionAnd remember: this is just the beginning. The full game will feature 1,809 hand-drawn cards, multiple sets to complete, a fully-upgradable retro-futuristic workstation, a totally above-board black market, and much more.Get in touch with Team Ballistic HQ & other recruitsGot something to report or share with Team Ballistic HQ? Then be a good recruit and reach out to us in the Steam forums or on Discord! Also if you enjoyed your time with the demo, please consider wishlisting the game.For now, clock in, and start your pack-opening mission.The briefing is over.Get ripping!— Team Ballistic

newsitems.title: The Rip It! Card Collector Demo is Available Now!
newsitems.author: Connor
newsitems.contents: Attention, Recruit!The Rip It! Card Collector demo is now available to play ahead of the Steam Next Fest. This gives you the unique chance to already tear open packs, discover ultra-rare cards, and start filling your binder. Here is what you can do in the demo:Open card packs of various typesSort your new cards into your binderSell duplicates for extra moneyLevel up and unlock upgradesUse the Rip Rig to open multiple packsPlay at your own pace with relaxing, incremental progressionShake the piggybank to get cash!Play ahead of the full launch on October 30Release DateThe release date is locked in:Rip It! Card Collector launches on October 30th 2026No need to wait for launch, recruit: just play the demo to scratch that card collector itch already!Fresh haul? Inspect cards to check out the artwork before you slot them.Next FestRip It! Card Collector will also be taking part in Steam Next Fest from October 19th. This means the demo will be live throughout the event.Next Fest is all about discovering upcoming games, so consider this Team Ballistic's official field test. Then, on October 30th, the full operation begins and Rip It! Card Collector will launch on Steam. FAQsWhen is the demo available? The Rip It! Card Collector demo is available now on Steam.What’s in the demo? The core game loop, ripping packs, filling your binder, selling duplicates and getting the first upgrades for your workstation. There are 369 cards of various rarities to find in the demo (the full game will have 1,809 cards).Will the demo be part of Steam Next Fest? Yes! Rip It! Card Collector will be taking part in Steam Next Fest from October 19th.When does the full game launch? Rip It! Card Collector launches on Steam on October 30th 2026.Can I share or stream the demo? Absolutely. Feel free to stream, record and post about your time with the demo and tag us so we share it!Instagram | TikTok | YouTube | BlueSky | XHelp us fine-tune our operationsTeam Ballistic recruits from around the world are currently stress-testing the operation and we’d love to hear how your first shift went: Tell us what felt good and what could maybe use some work. Send your feedback through the Steam forums or our official Discord ahead of our launch on 30 October.Enjoy your time with the demo? A demo review and a wishlist would look good on your personnel file. For now, clock in, and start ripping!-- Team Ballistic

newsitems.title: Get your own card in Rip It! Card Collector
newsitems.author: Ami CW
newsitems.contents: As a new recruit to Team Ballistic, you need to collect all CritKin cards, which depict animals/creatures mixed with elements: There are 🔥fire cats🐱, 🌿nature cyclopes👁️, 🪐cosmic dogs🐶,... But what Critkin would you like to collect? How to participate in this community competitionDraw your own card.Join our official Discord.UPDATED: Post your drawing in the card-art-competition channel by October 12, 2026. The deadline has been extended by 1 week!  What you can winThe best drawings will be selected for our 9 special promo cards, which everyone will be able to collect, admire, and frame in the game! Plus, your name will be shown in the credits.   No talent? No problem! Give us whatever fun, wacky or fluffy fantasy is floating around in your head... And even if it’s just a cool drawing of your zodiac sign! Just follow these guidelines 🖼️ 2D artwork (original and human-made only)📐 Resolution: 2048 × 2048 px ⚪ Transparent background 🐾 Feature a creature or animal 🔥 Include one of these elements:ElectricityFire Water Air Earth Ice Cosmic Venom Nature Optional: add a name suggestion You can find all competition rules in our Discord's card-art-competition channel. Here are two example Critkin to get inspired Briefing clear? Then get drawing, Recruit!

newsitems.title: Announcing Rip It! Card Collector – Collect 1809 cards to complete your binder
newsitems.author: Ami CW
newsitems.contents: Welcome, Recruit!  We’re excited to be revealing Rip It! Card Collector, our new game about finding, collecting, and sorting 1,809 trading cards into a binder! Your job is to not only purchase and rip packs on the hunt for rare Critkin pulls, but also to upgrade your arsenal of gadgets that help you complete your card collection more efficiently.  New recruit orientation starts now. Watch the trailer below for a quick briefing on what is expecting you! Rip It! Card Collector will feature:  1,809 hand-drawn cards to collect One binder and a whole range of sets to complete Duplicates sell for sweet, sweet profits An upgradable retro-futuristic workstation Relaxing, low-pressure incremental progression A totally above-board black market A radio, how retro!  Your very own piggy bank - Oink! Oink!   We’re looking for more creatures – Your chance to step up, Recruit! We’re running a community contest on our official Discord, where your creature artwork could be selected to appear on one of our 9 ultra-rare promo cards in the game! Join the ranks and share your artwork to make a chance to leave your mark.  How to support the mission: wishlist nowReady to enlist? Wishlist the game and stick around for a chance to get your hands on playtest builds down the line!  The briefing has been issued. Stay tuned for what’s next. Signing off from our top-secret and very 80s-inspired hideout, Team Ballistic
